{{Short description|Dutch physicist}}
'''Huib Johan Bakker''' (born 2 March 1965) is a Dutch physicist working in the field of ultrafast spectroscopy.  He has been president of research institute [[AMOLF]] since 1 February 2016.

==Career==
Bakker was born on 2 March 1965 in [[Haarlem]].<ref name=cv>{{cite web|author=|url=http://www.amolf.nl/fileadmin/Docs_in_pdf/Research/Ultrafast_spectro/1204_cv_bakker_2012.pdf|title=Curriculum Vitae|language=|publisher=AMOLF|date=|accessdate=20 February 2016}}{{dead link|date=November 2017 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> He studied physical chemistry at the [[Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam]], and obtained his master's degree in 1987. He subsequently became a PhD student under [[Ad Lagendijk]] at the [[AMOLF]] research institute. Bakker received his doctorate cum laude in 1991 with a thesis titled:"Time-resolved vibrational spectroscopy with picosecond infrared pulses".<ref name=cv/><ref name=nwo>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.nwo.nl/en/news-and-events/news/2016/huib-bakker-appointed-as-new-director-of-fom-institute-amolf.html |title=Huib Bakker appointed as new director of FOM Institute AMOLF |publisher=[[Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research]] |date=29 January 2016 |accessdate=20 February 2016}}</ref> Between 1991 and 1994 he was a scientific assistant at the Institute of Semiconductor Technologies of [[RWTH Aachen University]] in Germany.<ref name=cv/>

In 1995 Bakker returned to the Netherlands to become scientific group leader at AMOLF. Six years later he started as professor of Ultrafast Spectroscopy of Molecules in the Condensed Phase at the [[University of Amsterdam]].<ref name=uva>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.uva.nl/nieuws-agenda/nieuws/content/2016/02/huib-bakker-nieuwe-directeur-fom-instituut-amolf.html |title=Huib Bakker nieuwe directeur FOM-instituut AMOLF |language=Dutch |publisher=University of Amsterdam |date=2 February 2016 |accessdate=20 February 2016}}</ref> At AMOLF Bakker is group leader of research on ultrafast spectroscopy.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.amolf.nl/research/ultrafast-spectroscopy/ |title=Ultrafast Spectroscopy |language= |publisher=AMOLF |date= |accessdate=20 February 2016}}</ref> In 2003 he became head of the department of molecular nanophysics.<ref name=uva/> In his research at AMOLF Bakker has been founder of a technique which uses special non-linear spectroscopics, which helps researchers in determining the molecular mobility and structure of water in complex systems.<ref name=nwo/>

Bakker became adjunct director of AMOLF on 1 September 2015. On 1 February 2016 he succeeded [[Vinod Subramaniam]] as director, who became rector-magnificus of the [[Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam]].<ref name=uva/>

==Awards and honors==
In 2005 Bakker received the gold medal of the [[Royal Netherlands Chemical Society]].<ref name=nwo/> Bakker was elected a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 2015.<ref name=knaw>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/14892 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160220152407/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/14892 |title=Huib Bakker |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |archive-date=20 February 2016 |accessdate=20 February 2016}}</ref> The academy called him "a renowned expert on the molecular properties of water and ice".<ref name=knaw/>
